summary: The Imperium Party returned to power in Canada and named its cabinet, with George as Prime Minister and limao_mao as Minister of War.

evidence.document_type: Cabinet announcement posted by George | Calgary
evidence.key_text: A NEW GOVERNMENT IS FORMED. The @Imperium Party is back in Canada, the @Cabinet for the term is: Prime Minister @George | Calgary; Deputy Prime Minister @Vicky151 | Western_Canada; Minister of Treasury @Nautical77 | Seattle; Minister of Foreign Affairs @Poopypoop112 | Ungava; Minister of Growth and Internal Development @TOSd | Ahousat; Minister of War @limao_mao | Wilhelmina; Speaker is @Bon_Kranch | Abbotsford. Glory to Canada. God Bless the Imperium.
evidence.ocr_notes: Slogan reads "God Bless the Imperium" — the party, not the nation. Role badge on the author reads SEAF. Town affiliations are given for every minister, which makes each one resolvable in the scan archive.

analyst_notes: Two things lift this above a routine reshuffle. First, the wording is "back in Canada" — a party returning to office, which implies a prior term and a contested or at least alternating politics rather than a permanent ruler. Second, a distinct Minister of War portfolio is named in the same breath as Treasury and Foreign Affairs, so the post is standing rather than created for a crisis. Every minister is tagged with a town, so the whole cabinet can be located on the map and checked for rank and activity. The jingoistic slogan is a party signature and should not be read as a statement of hostile intent toward any particular nation.
why_it_matters: Canada has a returning government with a standing war portfolio. Mapping the cabinet against town strength is a cheap, concrete next step.
